'''Serik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an officer in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], he discovered that the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] found a way to coordinate their movements in the jungle with military precision. He sent a Republic-allied individual and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-5D1]] to decipher the secret code.<ref name="STL" />
